biography_english:
A Xenobian born in the city of Valna in Charlom who formerly captained the Holy Knights of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  He came to Valeria to recover the sword Brynhildr at the behest of King Tristan of Xenobia. He joined the Walister Resistance after aiding {hero} in freeing Duke Ronwey.
  He was garrisoned in Rhime when the Bakram invaded, and went missing thereafter. It is now known he is imprisoned in the dungeon of Heim Castle.

Xenobiano nacido en la ciudad de Valna, Charlom, que fue capitan de los Caballeros Santos del Reino de Nueva Xenobia.

  Estaba destinado en Rhime cuando invadieron los bakram y desaparecio. Se sabe que esta preso en las mazmorras del castillo de Heim.
